name: Securities Transaction Price 6
definition: Descriptive fields capturing where no strike price is known.

Pending.name: Pending
Pending.definition: Price is currently not available, but pending.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency that will be used but for which no price is yet known.

DigitalToken.name: Digital Token
DigitalToken.definition: Specifies the digital token when the number of units may not be known.
